question: Identify the state abbreviations where, for both male and female legislators, the retention rate remains greater than zero at specific intervals of 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 years after their first term start date. A legislator is considered retained if they are serving on December 31 of the respective year. Only include states where both gender cohorts maintain non-zero retention rates at all six of these time points during the first decade of service.

WITH first_term AS (
    SELECT 
        lt.id_bioguide,
        l.gender,
        lt.state,
        MIN(CAST(SUBSTR(lt.term_start, 1, 4) AS INT)) as first_term_year
    FROM legislators_terms lt
    JOIN legislators l ON lt.id_bioguide = l.id_bioguide
    GROUP BY lt.id_bioguide, l.gender, lt.state
),
years AS (
    SELECT 0 as y
    UNION ALL SELECT 2
    UNION ALL SELECT 4
    UNION ALL SELECT 6
    UNION ALL SELECT 8
    UNION ALL SELECT 10
),
retention_check AS (
    SELECT 
        ft.id_bioguide,
        ft.gender,
        ft.state,
        ft.first_term_year,
        ft.first_term_year + y as check_year,
        y,
        CASE WHEN lt.term_end IS NULL OR CAST(SUBSTR(lt.term_end, 1, 4) AS INT) > (ft.first_term_year + y) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as retained
    FROM first_term ft
    JOIN years y ON 1=1
    JOIN legislators_terms lt ON ft.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
    WHERE CAST(SUBSTR(lt.term_start, 1, 4) AS INT) <= (ft.first_term_year + y)
),
retention_by_state_gender_year AS (
    SELECT 
        state,
        gender,
        y,
        SUM(CASE WHEN retained = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as retained_count_at_check
    FROM retention_check
    GROUP BY state, gender, y
),
state_retention AS (
    SELECT 
        state,
        gender,
        y,
        MAX(CASE WHEN retained_count_at_check > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_retention
    FROM retention_by_state_gender_year
    GROUP BY state, gender, y
)
SELECT DISTINCT sr.state
FROM state_retention sr
WHERE sr.gender = 'M' AND sr.y = 0 AND sr.has_retention = 1
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM state_retention sr2 WHERE sr2.state = sr.state AND sr2.gender = 'M' AND sr2.y = 2 AND sr2.has_retention = 1)
